text: Crawls of large sitemaps stop with timeouts after about forty minutes.

The staging crawl failed repeatedly today; the log alert named crawler.timeout.
The staging proxy dropped idle connections; the proxy idle limit was raised.
Users see server errors on every search since this morning (search.5xx in the alerts).
Writes to the index failed around midnight; the operations alert links logs:incident:252611907407520b065c5a06cf50cda7.
The nightly staging crawl stopped with crawler.fetch_timeout shortly before midnight.
The crawl was restarted after the upstream host recovered.

Some updated documents did not appear; we suspect the index write failed.
